g.text: UML - independently approved synthetic funding correction
original / reversing legs : exact signed-i64 strings
current grants / queues / expiry : checked after locks
reason : requested / receipt observed / not observed / inquiry unavailable
Eligible source: one positive CUSTOMER leg and
one negative SETTLEMENT leg from SYNTHETIC_FUNDING.
Source + ordered account locks precede live authority checks.
Held funds and account restrictions remain enforced.
No payment, incoming/return, periodic fee or accrual reversal.
